Given the validator flags the connection lines specifically (not the node declarations), the flowchart genre evidently requires an explicit keyword to introduce a connection line — a bare `id -> id` is being parsed as an attempt to declare a node named `checkcounters`, which collides with genre rules. I've composed the corrected file using an explicit `edge` keyword for each connection, keeping every id, label and branch exactly as specified.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to human operator"

edge checkcounters -> errorsfound
edge errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
edge errorsfound -> escalate "no"
edge clearcounters -> monitor
```

Please run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js X.fd` on this — if `edge` is not the correct keyword either, the error message will name the actual required spelling (per the docs: "Retired spellings are hard errors whose message names the replacement"), and I'll correct it from that message rather than guessing again.
